title: Collection of Blood Samples for the Development of Circulating Tumorous DNA Sequencing by NGS From Liquid Biopsies at Centre Oscar Lambret
official: Collection of Blood Samples for the Development of Circulating Tumorous DNA Sequencing by NGS From Liquid Biopsies at Centre Oscar Lambret
summary: This is a single-center, non-interventional study involving patients undergoing blood sampling within the FRESH program. The study aims to develop local genomic profiling test based on liquid biopsy using NGS. The ultimate objective is to offer this analysis to patients as part of their routine care at Centre Oscar Lambret.
